swiftjxl-cli 2.1.0-dev.2 — JPEG XL
USAGE: swiftjxl-cli [OPTIONS] <command> [OPTIONS]

COMMANDS
  capabilities [--json]      Report executable command support.
  inspect, validate         Inspect headers or validate the supported scalar frame.
  help [command]             Show global or command-specific help.
  version                    Show the development version.
  encode, decode, transcode
                            Reserved; codec algorithms are unavailable (exit 4).

Requires Swift 6.2 or later to build; Apple OS baseline 26.0. CLI hosts: macOS/Linux.
Inspection and validation are available. Encoding/decoding file adapters remain unavailable.

OPTIONS
  -h, --help                 Show this help; also: help [command].
  --version                  Show the development version.
  -v, -vv ... -vvvvv         Increase verbosity (maximum 5).
  --verbose LEVEL           Set verbosity to 1..5 or + through +++++.
  --verbose=LEVEL            Equivalent explicit form; -verbose: LEVEL is accepted.
  -q, --quiet                Suppress optional diagnostics; errors remain visible.

VERBOSITY (stderr only; default 0)
  1 summary; 2 command stages; 3 capability details; 4 elapsed timing;
  5 bounded diagnostic trace. Levels are cumulative. Quiet conflicts with verbosity.
  Payload bytes, metadata, raw addresses and input/output paths are never logged.

EXIT STATUS
  0 success; 2 invalid usage; 3 malformed input; 4 unsupported feature;
  5 resource/deadline; 6 I/O/storage failure (including a closed pipe);
  7 internal failure; 130 user cancellation.

MANUAL
  man swiftjxl-cli (installed with the executable by Scripts/install-cli.sh).

EXAMPLES
  swiftjxl-cli -h
  swiftjxl-cli help capabilities
  swiftjxl-cli capabilities --json -vv
  swiftjxl-cli capabilities -verbose: 3

SWIFTJXL-CLI(1)          Swift Image Compression Suite         SWIFTJXL-CLI(1)

N NA AM ME E
     swiftjxl-cli - inspection, validation and capability reporting for
     SwiftJXL

S SY YN NO OP PS SI IS S
     s sw wi if ft tj jx xl l- -c cl li i [_ o_ p_ t_ i_ o_ n_ s] _ c_ o_ m_ m_ a_ n_ d [_ o_ p_ t_ i_ o_ n_ s]

D DE ES SC CR RI IP PT TI IO ON N
     This development tool inspects headers and validates the complete
     supported scalar JPEG XL frame using the public decoder. It also provides
     help, version and executable capability reporting. This is not a general
     JPEG XL validator.  Reserved encode, decode and native transcode return 4
     without opening input, consuming standard input or creating output.
     Build with Swift 6.2 or later in Swift 6 language mode.  Apple OS minimum
     is 26.0.  CLI hosts are macOS and Linux; consult qualification records
     for executed coverage.

C CO OM MM MA AN ND DS S
     c ca ap pa ab bi il li it ti ie es s [ [- -- -j js so on n] ]
            Report executable support. Inspect and validate are available;
            encode and decode file adapters remain unavailable. JSON is one
            document on stdout.

     h he el lp p [ [c co om mm ma an nd d] ]
            Show global or command-specific help. No arguments also show
            global help.

     v ve er rs si io on n
            Show the development version.

     i in ns sp pe ec ct t, , v va al li id da at te e
            Require -i/--input PATH; a hyphen reads stdin. Inspect reports
            supported headers, without checking pixel integrity. Validate
            decodes the entire supported frame in memory and discards pixels.
            Supports unsigned greyscale Modular, 8 through 16 meaningful bits,
            dimensions up to 1024, one frame/group and compressed input at
            most 4 MiB. Unsupported profiles return 4.  Optional -o/--output
            PATH writes a report; the default is stdout.  Use --json for
            structured output, including pixelPayloadValidated.  File reports
            publish atomically; --overwrite permits replacement of an existing
            regular file. Input aliases and output symlinks are refused.
            Failure preserves any previous report; partial stdout cannot be
            rolled back.

     I In ns sp pe ec ct ti io on n a an nd d v va al li id da at ti io on n l li im mi it ts s
            Input format is jxl or jpeg-xl. Backend is automatic (default) or
            scalar-cpu; accelerated is unavailable. Copy policy defaults to
            require-sharing; allow-copy is accepted. Threads is a ceiling from
            1 to 8; one worker is used.  Maximum memory is positive bytes,
            default 1073741824, including command buffers and codec admission;
            it is not a process RSS ceiling.  Timeout is positive finite
            seconds, at most 31536000, default 120, checked cooperatively
            across input, codec and output. Pipe polling checks every 25 ms;
            filesystem calls depend on operating-system scheduling. Ctrl+C
            returns 130.  Mode, max-error and output-format do not apply to
            these two commands.

O OP PT TI IO ON NS S
     - -h h, , - -- -h he el lp p
            Show help, including after a command.

     - -- -v ve er rs si io on n
            Show the development version.

     - -v v, , - -v vv v, , - -v vv vv v, , - -v vv vv vv v, , - -v vv vv vv vv v
            Increase diagnostic verbosity, up to 5.

     - -- -v ve er rb bo os se e L LE EV VE EL L, , - -- -v ve er rb bo os se e= =L LE EV VE EL L
            Set level to 1 through 5, or + through +++++. Bare verbose
            increments once.

     - -v ve er rb bo os se e: : L LE EV VE EL L, , - -v ve er rb bo os se e: :L LE EV VE EL L
            Equivalent explicit verbosity spelling; bare -verbose increments
            once.

     - -q q, , - -- -q qu ui ie et t
            Suppress optional diagnostics; errors remain visible. Conflicts
            with verbosity.

D DI IA AG GN NO OS ST TI IC C L LE EV VE EL LS S
     Default 0 reports errors only. Levels are cumulative: 1 summary; 2
     stages; 3 capability/configuration details; 4 elapsed timing; 5 bounded
     trace. Invalid levels or totals above 5 return 2.  Explicit levels set
     and repeated flags increment in argument order.  Diagnostics use stderr.
     Requested help/version/capability data uses stdout.  No payload bytes,
     metadata, raw addresses or input/output paths are logged.

R RE ES SE ER RV VE ED D C CO OD DE EC C S SY YN NT TA AX X
     Codec command help lists reserved -i/--input, -o/--output, --input-
     format, --output-format, --mode, --max-error, --backend, --copy-policy,
     --threads, --max-memory, --timeout, --overwrite and --json.
     Encode/decode/transcode are not implemented payload operations. A hyphen
     denotes standard input/output for inspect and validate. Default future
     mode is lossless and copy policy is require-sharing. No private
     intermediate image format is implemented.

E EX XI IT T S ST TA AT TU US S
     0 success/help/version; 2 invalid usage; 3 malformed input; 4 unsupported
     feature/layout/backend/format; 5 resource/deadline; 6 input/output
     failure including a closed pipe; 7 internal failure; 130 user
     cancellation.

E EX XA AM MP PL LE ES S
     swiftjxl-cli -h
     swiftjxl-cli help capabilities
     swiftjxl-cli capabilities --json -vv
     swiftjxl-cli capabilities -verbose: 3
     swiftjxl-cli capabilities --verbose=+++++

I IN NS ST TA AL LL LA AT TI IO ON N
     Scripts/install-cli.sh installs or updates the executable and this page
     together.  Use --prefix for an absolute prefix (default /usr/local),
     --destdir or DESTDIR for staging, and --binary for a prebuilt binary
     matching VERSION.  Files are PREFIX/bin/swiftjxl-cli and
     PREFIX/share/man/man1/swiftjxl-cli.1.  For custom prefixes use man -M
     PREFIX/share/man swiftjxl-cli, or configure MANPATH.  No index refresh is
     needed for direct lookup; no sudo runs automatically.

S SE EE E A AL LS SO O
     m ma an n(1)

     CLI.md and Documentation/Engineering/OS27CLI/README.md in the SwiftJXL
     repository.
